17 December 2003

## Circular to Intermediaries Conducting Type 1 or Type 8 Regulated Activity

## Allocation problem of China Life IPO

The SFC was informed this evening of certain IPO allocation information having been inaccurately posted in the newspapers.  The SFC has since contacted various relevant parties, including the sponsor and registrar, to ascertain the extent of the problem and its implications.  In addition, the SFC has strongly recommended the sponsor to make an urgent clarification as soon as possible tonight, and reprint the correct  allotment information in the newspapers tomorrow before trading commences.

The registrar has informed the Commission that information on the HKEx website is accurate.  On that basis, you should double check that your clients have indeed been allotted  the  shares  they  wish  to  sell  before  you  process  their  orders.    Alternatively, you  may  watch  out  for  revised  allotment  information  due  to  be  posted  in  the newspapers tomorrow.

In  the  event  where  this  problem  is  perceived  to  affect  your  compliance  with  the Securities  and  Futures  (Financial  Resources)  Rules  in  any  material  way,  you  are invited  to  discuss  your  case  with  the  Intermediaries  Supervision  Department  by calling 2842-7751.

Intermediaries &amp; Investment Products Securities and Futures Commission
